label: Gap
help: Clear gap needed between the edges of two lines.

label: Warn when lines are too close
help: Share of the line too close to other line that gives a warning.

label: Lines too close: problem above
help: Share of the line too close to other line that is a problem.

label: Density: warn above
help: mm of line per mm² in the densest 10 mm area.

label: Density: problem above
help: mm of line per mm² in the densest 10 mm area.

label: Smallest detail
help: Smallest closed shape that survives, across.

label: Small details: problem above
help: How many closed shapes may be smaller than the smallest detail.

label: Crossings: problem above
help: How many places score lines may cross.

label: Line on other line: problem above
help: How much line may lie on other line.

label: Same line within
help: Lines nearer than this are the same line.

label: Join ends within
help: Ends nearer than this are joined.

label: Report gaps up to
help: Gaps wider than the join distance and up to this are reported, never closed.
